description: Ask for a service-credit review of one paid call. For a basket, pass line or sku. Claims older than 72 hours are rejected. This does not move sats or cash.

call_id.description: Call or order id from the buy receipt.

description.description: What failed, in a sentence or two.

line.description: Line index when the order has more than one line. Omit it when only one line can be claimed. (minimum 0).

sku.description: SKU of the line to claim when the order has more than one line.

name: claim_failed_call

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Claim failed call
